import numpy as np
n_qubits = 4
coupling = 1.0
field = 0.73
def _pack_pair(result):
    codes, coeffs = result
    codes = np.asarray(codes, dtype=float)
    coeffs = np.asarray(coeffs, dtype=float)
    header = np.asarray(
        [codes.ndim, *codes.shape, coeffs.ndim, *coeffs.shape],
        dtype=float,
    )
    return np.concatenate((header, codes.ravel(), coeffs.ravel()))
assert np.allclose(_pack_pair(build_open_tfim_pauli_terms(n_qubits, coupling, field)), target)
